title: Recover an oblique CT plane across real reconstruction kernels
question: A target from a genuinely different CT reconstruction kernel removes exact pixel equality and may increase registration difficulty without changing geometry tolerance or tool access.
prior_findings: Not established: fresh Terra/high passes in 272 seconds at 0.0356 mm RMS versus 3 mm tolerance. The unchanged public-input author solver with 512 starts also recovers the cross-kernel target to 0.034 mm RMS. Initial 64-start misses affect both cross-kernel and matched same-kernel targets, so they do not isolate a reconstruction effect.
next_action: Retire this snapshot. Preserve the trace and source/geometry audit. Real cross-acquisition or modality successors need independent correspondence truth and an adequate transform model; none was run here.
